data = cells('Knot measurements', 'B702:C706')
pts = sorted([(row[0], row[1]) for row in data])
def interp(x):
    if x <= pts[0][0]: return pts[0][1]
    if x >= pts[-1][0]: return pts[-1][1]
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        x1, y1 = pts[i]
        x2, y2 = pts[i+1]
        if x1 <= x <= x2:
            if x1 == x2: return y1
            return y1 + (y2 - y1) * (x - x1) / (x2 - x1)
all_x = [2.0, 18.0] + [p[0] for p in pts if 2.0 < p[0] < 18.0]
all_x = sorted(list(set(all_x)))
integral = 0.0
for i in range(len(all_x)-1):
    x_a = all_x[i]
    x_b = all_x[i+1]
    ya = interp(x_a)
    yb = interp(x_b)
    integral += (x_b - x_a) * (ya + yb) / 2.0
result = round(integral, 2)
